description: Weekend Parking Occupancy - April 2021 is a dataset listed in City of Oakland open data portal (data.oaklandca.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Oakland. This dataset includes weekend on-street parking occupancy data collected in select commercial districts on April 10-11, 2021 and April 17-18, 2021. Data is available for Fruitvale, Grand Lake, Montclair, Rockridge, and Temescal. This data supports the suite of parking proposals presented to City Council on June 1, 2021. Coverage: Oakland. The portal files it under the category Infrastructure. Its tags are fruitvale, grand lake, montclair, oakdot, oakland. The table has 49 columns. The portal shows 2021-07-02 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-oaklandca-gov-portal.
